source_refs.note: 14.16.2 Social Issues: a main subheading of 14.16 Economic, social and political issues, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 319-319.

items: Vulnerable populations, such as children, the elderly, and low-income communities are disproportionately affected by air pollution.
Chronic exposure to polluted air reduces the overall quality of life. This affects social well-being and community health.
Severe air pollution can force people to migrate from the unhealthy polluted areas to places with better air quality, leading to social displacement and associated challenges.
